This month, our teams across Munich, Berlin, Amsterdam, Madrid, Dublin and London gathered for our annual Summer Sessions. 

We do this every year because a roadmap will only get you so far – people still have to know each other to actually be able to pull it off together. Growth doesn't happen in isolation, it happens when people genuinely know each other, collaborate across functions, and share a common vision.

Each office ran its own local session first. Then we brought everyone together, including our exec team on stage for some unscripted team games. Nothing polished about it, and that was the point. 

We also had the privilege of hosting board member Judith Dada, co-CEO of Langdock. Her talk on how AI is reshaping our world genuinely captivated the room. In one thing, Judith and I are fully aligned: Innovation is technology-driven. Change is people-driven.  

To top it all off, the Personio Band returned to the stage, bringing together incredible cross-functional talent from Product, Sales, and Engineering... I’m not so sure about my talent as lead singer, though.

I’ve heard from so many people how much this day brought them closer to colleagues. And walking through the office now, I keep spotting people in the new Personio cap. Small thing, but our People team clearly made an impact with it. 

A cap alone won't get you far. But the people wearing it will.

Women in the EU earn 12% less than men. In Germany, it's 16% per hour.

That gap is exactly what the EU Pay Transparency Directive is meant to close, and it's already in force.

Three things change immediately:
💰 You can't post a job without a salary range. "Competitive" doesn't count anymore.
❌ You can't ask candidates about their salary history. Your offer has to be based on the role, not what they earned somewhere else.
🤔 Employees can ask what people in similar roles earn, split by gender, and you have to answer, accurately and fast.

None of this works without clean pay data. If you can't explain how a number was calculated, that's the gap to close first.

Start here: audit your open job postings for missing salary ranges, and decide now who owns pay-data requests when they land on your desk.

#PayTransparency #HRCompliance #EUDirective #PeopleOps #FutureOfWork

In 2021, I set our team a goal... which frankly, felt a little unreasonable at the time:

Get as many users as people living in Munich.

Back then, our users were closer to Palma de Mallorca, about 440,000 people. It was a big goal. We went for it anyway.

We've now hit 1.6 million.

That's Munich's whole population, using Personio.

Five years ago, this was just a goal. Now it's real. We didn’t get there alone. 16,000 companies across Europe trust us with the people who make their business run. 

To celebrate, our billboards are up across Munich. If you're out and about, keep an eye out.

Feels good to see it in the real world.

To everyone on the team who made this happen, thank you. And to every customer who opens Personio each day: this milestone is yours as much as it is ours. 

We don’t take that trust for granted. Every piece of your feedback shapes what we build next – in Q2 alone, our team shipped 70+ customer facing updates. We keep showing up with product improvements because 1.6 million people deserve nothing less.

⚽️ Growing up with football being SUPER present in our house – I'm talking Chelsea christmas ornaments, owning 20 different "dicky dirts" (as my dad calls them), having a cousin called Chelsea (and not because it's a pretty girl's name) – women's football still wasn't very visible to me. That's only really changed in the last few years.

So being at Stadion Lichterfelde on a Sunday, in that kind of female-empowering energy, and getting to be part of building visibility for this sport – that means a lot to me.

Last week that looked like stepping away from my laptop and spending a couple hours at the stadium with Stöcki, Michèle, Vanessa and Toma from FC Viktoria Berlin, filming content with Benjamin Bakali. No big studio setup, just an iPhone, couple mics, and Susanne Schlossbauer's amazing prep.

What stuck with me is the story behind this club. FC Viktoria was taken over by six women entrepreneurs at a point when barely anyone took women's football seriously as a business. They built it anyway – like a startup, with clear roles and one shared goal: make it into the first division. Success didn't come first. The investment did.

Personio is Viktoria's back-of-jersey partner since July. And while Viktoria's already been playing in the 2nd Bundesliga since 2025, now it's about backing that momentum, and it's really exciting to be part of this journey as they push to make it into the first division.

I get to be a very small part of telling that story, partly because I live in this city and can actually make it to the games on weekends, partly because I just care about this deeply.

This one's just a heart project for me 💙🩵

#BuildingPersonio

What is the best way to keep AI spend under control? A few months ago, most conversations I had with other CEOs were about getting teams to actually use AI. 

In practice, when adoption works, it frees people up from busywork and lets them focus on higher-value work. The real challenge that comes next is visibility: knowing where your investment is going. 

At Personio, our marketing team for example used Claude Code and n8n to streamline end-to-end task execution and data workflows – delivering six-figure cost efficiencies, so that the team could move into more strategic campaign work. That’s the upside. But with thousands of employees building like this, the natural next question is: 

Tracking usage and cost across different models, providers and teams gets complicated quickly, even more so if you want to put them in context of your salary budgets. 

That’s why we built dashboards to help you easily track AI spend next to  your compensation figures inside Personio. It uses the Anthropic Analytics API and analyses aggregated data – of course without accessing any content. We have been using this feature for a couple of weeks internally and it has helped us deeply understand token usage across teams and departments accurately. It also replaced a manually built dashboard that needed updating and maintenance.

We're bringing this same capability to our customers: You will be able to connect tools like Claude, Langdock, OpenAI's ChatGPT , Microsoft Copilot and Google Gemini to Personio to see which teams are spending how many tokens and on which tools. 

Because it lives inside Personio alongside the rest of your workforce data instead of a separate tool, you're able to put it in context (adoption by team, salary-ai-spend ratio by department, tool usage against role) and include it into your reports. 

Want to understand how AI spend is distributed across your organisation and tools? Or salary-ai-spend ratio for individuals and teams? Sign up via the link in the comments.

🎙️ We're launching 'This Week in HR', a weekly video series from Personio Newsroom. Each week, one story, the real numbers, and what HR teams should actually do about it.

First up: salary budgets are shrinking and wellbeing is officially beating pay in the retention conversation.

Since 2022, top-end salary budgets across 16,000+ UK and EU companies have nearly halved, from 10% down to 5.9%. 

Meanwhile, 44% of UK employers now formally rank wellbeing above pay in their retention strategy. The way companies compete for talent is shifting, and fast.

But... there's good news! The first move actually isn't about spending more. It's about understanding what your team actually values, auditing what you already offer, and making sure the two line up. Small shift, big difference ✨

Watch the first episode below and follow Personio for weekly drops 🎬

37% of employers are planning to cut permanent hiring because of the Employment Rights Act. Not because business is slowing, because compliance costs are rising and no one wants to lock in headcount before knowing what it'll cost them 🤔

CIPD's latest Labour Market Outlook (2,000+ UK employers surveyed) lays out the real picture:
→ Hiring intent is still there — but permanent commitments are the first thing getting paused
 → More than half of employers expect workplace conflict to increase as the reforms take hold
 → The gap between "we want to hire" and "we're not ready to commit" is where the real strategic pressure sits right now

Three things to do this week:
1️⃣ Align your hiring budget against the cost pressure you're likely facing, know where capacity expectations need to shift
 2️⃣ Run your Employment Rights Act compliance checklist and get the team aligned on it
3️⃣ Check our employment law guide against CIPD's findings, and bring both to leadership so your hiring plans reflect what's coming, not last quarter's assumptions

We've put together the full breakdown of every ERA change, what's already in force, and what's coming next. Link in the comments 👇 

Follow for your weekly update 🔔 

#EmploymentRightsAct #UKEmploymentLaw #HRCompliance #TradeUnionLaw

posts.content:
This weekend, people were attacked for showing up as themselves. For marching through the streets of Berlin and celebrating love. One person died. We are devastated. Our thoughts are with their family, their friends, and everyone affected by this tragedy. And we want to say this clearly: what happened is unacceptable.

It’s not just an attack on LGBTQ+ people. It's an attack on a freedom that belongs to everyone: the freedom to gather, to march, to be visible in public space without fear. That freedom is not a nice-to-have in a democracy. It's foundational. When it's threatened for one group, it's weaker for all of us.

At Personio, we firmly believe that people should have the right to express who they are and feel safe doing it, at work and everywhere else. That belief isn't a policy. It's something we try to live out.

Our Berlin office hosted its summer celebration last week. This year, we tied it to Pride, because Pride is about more than a party. It's about the right to exist openly, without fear. Our Culture Champions programme funded a drag king performance, and we used the moment to talk about why visibility matters, why safety matters, and why we keep showing up for this community year after year.

Watching people dance, laugh, and feel genuinely celebrated in a space we built together... and then hearing what happened two days later in the same city.

It's a lot to sit with.

But it makes us more certain, not less. Certain that these spaces matter. That showing up for your people, loudly, joyfully, repeatedly, is never the wrong call. That when the world gets harder, you don't quietly step back from the things you believe in.

Personio believes in love, not hate. We always have. And we believe a free society is one where everyone can show up as themselves, in public, without fear. Not just in our offices, but on every street. This is why we'll keep creating spaces where every person feels safe, seen, and celebrated – and stand up when they are threatened.

To everyone in Berlin, across Germany, and beyond who is hurting right now: we see you. We're with you. 🏳️‍🌈

Die Frage ist längst nicht mehr, ob KI in HR ankommt. Die spannendere Frage lautet: Warum gelingt der Einsatz manchen Unternehmen und anderen nicht?

Wer heute über KI in HR spricht, spricht oft über Tools. Der eigentliche Unterschied entsteht jedoch an anderer Stelle. Unternehmen brauchen Menschen, die wissen, welche Aufgaben sich überhaupt für KI eignen, wie gute Prompts aussehen und an welchen Stellen menschliches Urteilsvermögen unersetzlich bleibt.

Deshalb wird es morgen in meinem Webinar beim Personio HR Summer Sprint sehr praxisnah. Die Teilnahme ist kostenfrei. 

Hier geht es zur Anmeldung:
https://lnkd.in/dK9MTrqk

Wir schauen uns gemeinsam an, wo HR beim Thema KI heute wirklich steht und welche Anwendungsfälle sich bereits heute sinnvoll einsetzen lassen. 

Ich zeige euch außerdem die Prompts, die ich selbst regelmäßig nutze, z.B. um Stellenanzeigen auf Bias zu prüfen, Bewerbungsgespräche besser vorzubereiten oder Feedback strukturiert auszuwerten. Alles Prompts, die ihr direkt mitnehmen und im Arbeitsalltag einsetzen könnt!

Wenn ihr Lust auf konkrete Beispiele, sofort einsetzbare Prompts und ehrliche Einblicke aus der Praxis habt, freue ich mich auf den Austausch mit euch.

Ich freue mich auf euch! 💜

posts.content:
The UK is now the most AI-forward country in Europe for HR... but most companies still can't say if it's paying off 👀 

55% of UK organisations are investing in AI for HR, up from 35% last year. That's 17 points ahead of the European average.

Employees aren't waiting on their employers either. Nearly a third say they now use AI regularly at work, up from under a quarter a year ago.

But, only 42% of UK companies say they've seen results from any of it.

Most of them have a readiness problem, not a technology one.

We put together a short video on exactly where the investment is going, what's got HR leaders worried and the three specific moves that separate companies getting value from AI and companies just buying more of it.

If you're the one making AI calls for your HR team, this one's for you. 🎥👇

Is your organisation still buying tools, or building readiness? Tell us in the comments.
